draft.title: Mars conjunct Chiron
draft.humanMoment: A tenant disputes an unexplained fee, then softens the demand before the landlord answers.
draft.developmentDetail: The receipts are on the table, but the tenant spends more time defending neighbors facing the same charge than naming the repayment owed personally.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Mars drives the dispute and direct demand, while Chiron carries the old wound around taking up enough space to make that demand without apology.
draft.aspectMechanic: Under the conjunction, the disputed fee, softened demand, and apology land in one exchange, making assertion difficult to separate from the fear that it was never allowed.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the demand keeps shifting toward the neighbors' losses, the landlord may answer the broader complaint while leaving the tenant's repayment unresolved.

judge.weakest: Mars drives the dispute and direct demand, while Chiron carries the old wound around taking up enough space to make that demand without apology.
judge.why: The scene is concrete, the bodies are clearly distinguished, the conjunction merges assertion with the wound around asserting, and the consequence follows naturally; the planetary dynamic is only slightly more explanatory than the other fields.
